identity: ONE original armoured soldier, the River Guard veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the man in a bronze-gold crested helmet with a teal plume, burgundy padded coat over bronze scale and plate armour with shoulder plates, a teal sash and tasset, bronze greaves and brown boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE tall upright spear with a hooked steel blade, the butt on the ground; the screen-RIGHT arm bears ONE tall bronze kite-shaped tower shield with raised vertical ribs. Preserve the spear, shield, helmet plume, sash and adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full spear blade, the shield, the plume, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, glow, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the spear or shield.

idle_h3_v1.action: A steady sentry idle that loops. He breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, he shifts his grip on the upright spear and settles the shield on his arm, the helmeted head turns slightly to look along the line, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: March in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with disciplined steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The spear is carried upright and the shield held at the side; the sash swings with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE spear thrust toward screen right. He brings the spear down level across his chest and draws it back as the knees bend, then lunges forward on the front leg and thrusts the hooked blade out to full reach at screen right beside the shield, pulls it back and raises the spear upright into the original stance. One thrust only; the shield stays on the screen-right arm.

hit_h3_v1.action: He flinches from an unseen blow and recovers completely. The helmeted head and shoulders rock backward, the shield swings out and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the spear and the shield, then he rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Nothing is seen hitting him: no arrow, blade, thrown object, spark or flash. The blue background never flashes or changes colour.

defend_h3_v1.action: Raise the tower shield up in front of the face and chest and bend the knees, bracing behind it with the spear still upright behind, then hold the covered guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying signal. He lifts the spear off the ground and raises it high overhead, holds it up briefly as a signal to the line, then lowers it back to the ground in the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly from standing. His knees buckle and he sinks onto one knee, leaning on the spear and shield, and stays there a moment. Then he tips forward and lies down on his front, finishing lying motionless with the head at screen left and the boots at screen right, the shield and spear lying on the ground beside him. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
